final: WITH patient_metrics AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, (SELECT AVG(l.ALB) FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID) - (SELECT AVG(l.TP) FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID) AS alb_minus_tp, (SELECT AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID)), sex_metrics AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_minus_tp) AS alb_minus_tp, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM patient_metrics GROUP BY SEX), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS mean_sex_aptt_minus_pt FROM sex_metrics) SELECT AVG(s.alb_minus_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(s.avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(s.avg_aptt_minus_pt - t.mean_sex_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_excess_aptt_minus_pt FROM sex_metrics s CROSS JOIN threshold t WHERE s.avg_aptt_minus_pt > t.mean_sex_aptt_minus_pt
